description.value:
Whether called aura, ki, chi, spirit, soul, or by countless other names across different cultures, every living creature radiates an invisible life force.

You devoted yourself to the study of this mysterious energy, learning to perceive its subtle flows and understand the principles that govern it.

While some Auramancers dedicate themselves to reading the auras of others, others learn to manifest their own life force into tangible form or suppress the energies of those around them.

Though your training has only introduced you to the fundamentals of this ancient discipline, it has granted you a unique perspective on the hidden currents that bind all living things.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Aura Control skill and Aura Lore skill.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.elara.feats.Item.HNUcleiLzOlNijpU]{Aura Control} skill feat.
